title: Notion
visualIntent: A calm workspace-editorial system with structured content blocks, quiet utility, and document-first clarity.

compositionRecipes.label: Notion default
compositionRecipes.whenToUse: Use this as the default build recipe whenever Notion is the locked primary reference.
compositionRecipes.heroStructure: Build a chapter-like hero with one dominant visual field, aggressive display hierarchy, and enough compositional tension that the page cannot be mistaken for a generic startup homepage.
sectionOrder: Closing chapter that preserves the reference tone.
compositionRecipes.headlineImageRelationship: Allow direct overlap or hard adjacency between headline and imagery when that preserves the reference tension; do not split them into disconnected polite columns.
layeringRules: Use overlap, crop tension, or chapter-field layering to keep the composition visibly art-directed.
Use one dominant foreground relationship and one subordinate supporting layer; do not stack decorative layers without purpose.
Every overlap, crop, or z-index shift should strengthen the selected reference rather than adding generic drama.
compositionRecipes.typeScaleRelationship: Use at least one oversized moment that sets the emotional scale before explanatory content arrives.
compositionRecipes.paletteDistribution: Palette dominance should stay restrained, tonal, and disciplined, with accent color used sparingly.
compositionRecipes.imageFraming: Imagery should behave like part of the design system's DNA, not a last-minute decorative filler layer.
compositionRecipes.asymmetry: Allow tension, crop pressure, and asymmetry when it preserves the reference family.
compositionRecipes.ctaPosture: Keep CTAs sparse, exact, and product-native.

typeSystemBehavior: Use display type with visible scale tension and chapter rhythm instead of evenly weighted marketing hierarchy.

paletteBehavior: Palette dominance should stay restrained, tonal, and disciplined, with accent color used sparingly.

Keep palette choices visibly native to the selected reference family.
sectionSkeletons: Closing chapter that preserves the reference tone.
antiPatterns: Do not normalize the selected reference into a tidier generic startup homepage just because the prompt is broad.
Do not drift into flashy gradients.
Do not drift into aggressive motion.
Do not drift into luxury product-launch theatrics.
Do not flatten the page into balanced cards and polite spacing if the reference depends on tension.
Do not let runtime overrides overpower the selected primary reference.
allowedVariation: Content, brand naming, and product specifics may change freely as long as the composition DNA remains recognizably native to the selected reference family.
You may vary the exact crop, chapter sequencing, or copy cadence, but the page must stay visibly editorial and reference-led.
Do not use variety as an excuse to fall back to generic AI-generated landing-page patterns.

exemplarCues.label: Editorial hero composition
cues: Use one dominant image field and one dominant display-type move.
Keep the composition tense enough that it avoids generic startup symmetry.
Let section rhythm feel chaptered rather than repetitively modular.
